character_sheet: The Hammerhead is a wide, armoured six-legged beast with a hammer for a head: a chest and abdomen under three rows of back armour and two rear fins, a neck in a collar of armour, a head and snout carrying a horn base with two great horn bars and a horn tip each side, a three-blade crest fan and two whisker ears, six two-piece legs (front, middle and rear pairs) and a stub tail (ModelHammerhead.createBodyLayer, ModelHammerhead.java:100-252). It has 240 HP, 75 attack and 20 armour (MobStats.HAMMERHEAD, createAttributes Hammerhead.java:76-85) and no boss bar (:47-48), wanders far and looks about (:65-69), and every third tick takes its revenge target, its stored target or the nearest living thing in an 18-block box — players, monsters and the attackable non-mobs (customServerAiStep :127-164, isSuitableTarget :189-196) — closing at 1.25 and, within seven blocks plus half the target's width, raising the attacking flag and biting on two dice (:152-156) for 75 with a knockback (doHurtTarget :101-113). Cactus cannot hurt it and whoever does becomes its revenge target (hurt :116-124). It spawns at night in the dark above y 50 under a clear air column with no other Hammerhead within 16 blocks (checkSpawnRules :228-237) in the Chaos biome (chaos_biome.json). Read it as a low, heavy charger: the six legs scissor, the hammer head swings on the neck, and everything nods with the bite.
size_notes: Drawn at x2.5 of the rig (HammerheadRenderer.java:25, applied :34-39; shadow 1.0 x 2.5) on a 222x256 sheet (ModelHammerhead.java:252); 3.0 x 5.0 block hitbox (ModEntities.java:107-109; the design's row writes [2.8,1.8] — the profile takes the registered size). The head assembly — neck, collar, horns, head, snout, fan and ears — is posed as one unit about the neck's pivot (:277-311).

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg) x the walking speed above a 0.1 threshold (zero below it): the front left and rear right legs swing +a about their rests (−0.087 / −0.349 on the upper piece, 0 on the lower), the front right and rear left −a; the middle pair swings on a wave an eighth of a period ahead (+pi/4), left +, right −
groups.plain: the six legs scissor with the walking speed, upper and lower piece together: front-left with rear-right, front-right with rear-left, the middle pair on its own phase
groups.math: a = amount > 0.1 ? cos(t * 1.3 * 0.33) * pi * 0.1 * amount : 0; a2 = amount > 0.1 ? cos(t * 1.3 * 0.33 + pi/4) * pi * 0.1 * amount : 0; leg_1.xRot = -0.087 + a, leg_1b.xRot = a; leg_1R.xRot = -0.087 - a, leg_1Rb.xRot = -a; leg_2.xRot = -0.052 + a2, leg_2b.xRot = a2; leg_2R.xRot = -0.052 - a2, leg_2Rb.xRot = -a2; leg_3.xRot = -0.349 - a, leg_3b.xRot = -a; leg_3R.xRot = -0.349 + a, leg_3Rb.xRot = a
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x wingspeed 0.33 = 0.429 rad/tick: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.429 = 14.65 ticks

groups.name: rear_fins
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.03 = 0.094 rad (5.4 deg) about +0.349 (left) and −0.349 (right, the negative wave)
groups.plain: the two rear fins sway slowly in and out together
groups.math: f = cos(t * 0.3 * 0.33) * pi * 0.03; back_armour_4.yRot = 0.349 + f; back_armour_4R.yRot = -0.349 - f
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.3 x wingspeed 0.33 = 0.099 rad/tick: the natural period is 63.5 ticks

groups.name: head_nod
groups.amplitude: attacking: pi x 0.13 = 0.408 rad (23 deg) added to every part's rest pitch (neck and collar 0.157, horn base 0.087, horn bars and tips 0.192, head 0.209, snout 0.611, fan centre −0.139, fan blades −0.209 / −0.331, ears 0.366); not attacking: the rests, still
groups.plain: the whole head assembly — neck, collar, horns, head, snout, fan and ears — nods as one while the attacking flag is set and holds its rest otherwise; it also turns a quarter of the look yaw at all times
groups.math: n = attacking ? cos(t * 1.3 * 0.33) * pi * 0.13 : 0; neck.xRot = neck_armour.xRot = n + 0.157; horn_base.xRot = n + 0.087; horn_1/2/L/R.xRot = n + 0.192; head.xRot = n + 0.209; snout.xRot = n + 0.611; fan1.xRot = n - 0.139; Lfan2/Rfan2.xRot = n - 0.209; Lfan3/Rfan3.xRot = n - 0.331; Lear/Rear.xRot = n + 0.366; every part's yRot = look yaw x 0.25 (fans and ears with their own offsets)
groups.phase: the synced DATA_ATTACKING byte (Hammerhead.java:42, set at :153 within reach, cleared at :161) selects the nod
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x wingspeed 0.33 = 0.429 rad/tick — the same rhythm as the stride (period 14.65 ticks)

behaviour: One speed-scaled stride at 0.429 rad/tick (a 14.7-tick period) above a walking-speed threshold of 0.1: the six legs scissor 18 degrees at top speed, upper and lower piece together, the front left with the rear right, the front right with the rear left, and the middle pair an eighth of a period ahead (ModelHammerhead.java:259-276). Standing still every leg rests.

The head assembly — neck, collar, horn base, two horn bars and two tips, head, snout, the three-blade fan and the two whisker ears — turns a quarter of the look yaw as one unit at all times (:277-291) and, while the synced DATA_ATTACKING byte is set (Hammerhead.java:42, raised at :153 within seven blocks plus half the target's width), nods 23 degrees at the stride's own 0.429 rad/tick about every part's rest pitch (:295-311); with the flag clear it holds the rest.

The two rear fins sway 5 degrees at 0.099 rad/tick (a 64-tick period) about ±0.349 (:292-294). The chest, abdomen, the three back armour plates and the tail stub are static; the walk position and the head pitch play no part.
The bite (doHurtTarget, Hammerhead.java:101-113) is rolled by the third-tick scan (:131-163) — nothing in the code fires an animation for it.

locked_bones_note: The design's section 6 ModelHammerhead row (geckolib_migration_design.md:449): 'head/snout [1.5,1] @1; chest/abdomen [2.5,1.3] @0.5; six upper/lower leg pairs [0.4,0.8] @0.5; tail [0.8,0.6] @0.25; fan root [1,0.4] @0.25'. head, snout, chest, abdomen and tail resolve as written. 'six upper/lower leg pairs' is not a bone name: taken as the twelve leg pieces — leg_1 / leg_1b, leg_1R / leg_1Rb, leg_2 / leg_2b, leg_2R / leg_2Rb, leg_3 / leg_3b, leg_3R / leg_3Rb (upper and lower, ModelHammerhead.createBodyLayer; the 'b' suffix is the lower piece). 'fan root' is not a bone name: taken as fan1, the centre blade of the crest fan (the blades Lfan2 / Lfan3 / Rfan2 / Rfan3 stay visual). The row writes the main size as [2.8,1.8]; the registration is 3.0 x 5.0 (ModEntities.java:107-109) — the profile takes the registered size (the shared laws).
